items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you stayed with your cousin, Mariana Staton, who lived on Park Avenue and 96th Street

ctx.x: You were thinking about going to NYU, which, had you done so, you would have entered with Wayne Shorter, because he entered NYU right at that time. But in any event, you stayed with your cousin, Mariana Staton, who lived on Park Avenue and 96th Street, and you spent some time there, but you weren’t comfortable in New York at that time.
No. I went back to... I thought about southern colleges, with the trees and everything, and the... Well, southern colleges, you know...
